name: 古啦多
evolution: 多多 → 多啦多 Lv.16 → 古啦多 Lv.36
description: 头部突起越复杂代表着年龄越大，突起内部充斥剧毒毒液，被一层外套膜包裹起来。遇到危险时，会释放更为强大的致幻毒素，但是并不致命。因此，部分洛克因为想要致幻体验，而专门寻找它们。
descriptionEn: The more complex the bulge on its head, the older the individual. The bulge is filled with highly toxic venom, wrapped in a mantle. When in danger, it releases an even stronger hallucinogenic toxin, but it is not lethal. Thus, some Roco specifically seek them out for the hallucinogenic experience.
